t.E155.agn: In 2010 EFSA set the ADI for Brown HT at 1.5 mg/kg body weight. Average intakes remained below the limit; it has been reported that it may be exceeded in high-consuming adults and children.
t.E155.body: In mice and rats almost all orally given Brown HT is excreted within 72 hours: 80–90% in faeces and 7–16.5% in urine. After 72 hours only about 0.05% of the dose remained in the tissues.
t.E155.eff.0.t: The daily limit may be exceeded
t.E155.prod: An azo dye produced by chemical synthesis.
t.E155.pw.0: According to EFSA, the daily intake limit may be exceeded in children who consume a lot of this dye.
t.E155.regx.0: ADI 1.5 mg/kg; may be exceeded in high consumers.
t.E155.summary: A synthetic reddish-brown azo dye. Used in chocolate-flavoured cakes and confectionery.
